messages.author: 6f9739ea511c7a89
messages.subject: Date objects -> bug?
parts:
Hi,

I'm new to Shiny love it already!

I've been having trouble with date columns; not sure if this is a bug.  Whenever I reference a dataframe with a Date column, I get this error:
 Error in Math.Date(x + ifelse(x == 0, 1, 0)) : 
  abs not defined for Date objects

Try this example:

server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  output$testing = reactiveTable(function() {
    x = data.frame(a=1,b=as.Date("12/15/2012","%m/%d/%Y"))
    x
  })  
})

ui.R
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  # Application title
  headerPanel("Miles Per Gallon"),
  
  sidebarPanel( ),
  
  mainPanel(tableOutput("testing"))
)
)

messages.author: 66aaf5d139ba9c7f
messages.subject: Re: Date objects -> bug?
parts:
outputTable uses xtable which doesn't play nice with dates. 

> library(xtable)
> xtable(x)

Error in Math.Date(x + ifelse(x == 0, 1, 0)) : 
  abs not defined for Date objects

If you are using dates you may be better using the xts package [ install.packages('xts')

The following should work

library(xts)
x <- xts( ... your time-series data ...)
xtable(data.frame(x))
